<action type="say">
Here’s how to cancel it directly with Frontier, assuming it’s a standard nonrefundable ticket and you’re okay with getting $0 back.

On Frontier’s website (browser)
1) Go to flyfrontier.com.  
2) Sign in:
   - Click “Sign In” (usually top right).
   - Enter the same email/password you use to see the reservation.
3) Open your trip:
   - Click “My Trips” or “My Trips / Check-In”.
   - Find your upcoming reservation and click on it to open the trip details.
4) Go to the cancel option:
   - On the trip detail page, look for a button/link like “Manage Trip,” “Change/Cancel,” or “Modify Trip.”
   - Click that, then choose “Cancel Flight” or “Cancel Trip.”
5) Review what happens if you cancel:
   - Frontier will show:
     - Whether you get $0 refund or some form of travel credit.
     - Whether extras (bags, seats, bundles) are refundable (often they’re not).
6) Confirm the cancellation:
   - Check any box acknowledging the terms (nonrefundable, credit rules).
   - Click the final “Cancel Trip” / “Confirm Cancellation” button.
7) Save confirmation:
   - Wait for the confirmation screen.
   - You should get an email with a cancellation confirmation and, if applicable, a credit.
   - Take a screenshot or save the page just in case.

On Frontier’s mobile app
1) Open the Frontier app and sign in with the same account.  
2) Tap “Trips” or “My Trips.”  
3) Select the upcoming trip you want to cancel.  
4) Tap “Manage Trip” or “Change/Cancel.”  
5) Choose “Cancel Flight” or “Cancel Trip.”  
6) Review the refund/credit info (likely $0 back or travel credit only).  
7) Accept the terms and tap the final “Cancel” / “Confirm” button.  
8) Check your email and/or the app’s wallet/credits section for any travel credit.

Key timing point:
- Do this before the scheduled departure time; once it’s treated as a no‑show, options are often more limited.

If you’d like, tell me what options you see on the trip’s “Manage” screen (exact wording/buttons), and I can guide you click‑by‑click from there.</action>
